intro_beach.text: You wake up, washed ashore on a lonely beach, naked as a newborn. Your skull pounds like a war drum and nausea twists your guts. You look left, then right: nothing but sand and sea. You try to remember what happened, but nothing comes. Absolutely nothing.

choices.text: Force your mind to remember who you are and what happened.

amnesia_realization.text: You dig deep into your memories, but your mind is as empty as a blank page. You cannot recall your past, the people you loved or hated, nor a single detail of your previous life. Even your own name escapes you. Just as despair creeps in, something in the sand catches your eye: a small metallic glint.

choices.text: Reach for the strange object buried in the sand.

discover_medallion.text: You pick up a small, old medallion half-buried in the sand. You open it. Inside, a short sentence is engraved. You read it.

choices.text: "Do not forget where you come from, my dear [USERNAME]."

decide_to_leave_beach.text: A sharp flash hits you: you recognize that name. It is yours. This is your name ! You have no idea who gave you this medallion, but it is the only lead you have. You hang it around your neck and take a deep breath. Staying on this empty shore will not bring your memories back. You turn away from the waves and head toward the rocky coast.

choices.text: Walk toward the rocky wall that seals the beach off from the mainland.

rock_wall.text: An imposing wall of stone rises ahead of you. If you want to leave the beach, you will have to overcome this obstacle. You feel tired and weak, your body still shaken by whatever happened before you woke up. Climbing will not be easy, but staying here is not an option.

choices.text: Try to climb the rocky wall anyway. (Strength DC 15)
Scan the area for a clever way up. (Intelligence DC 12)
Play it safe and look for another path along the cliff. (HP Penalty)

rock_climb_success.text: You decide to climb the wall by brute force. You grab onto the rock and start pulling yourself up, one painful movement at a time. You slip more than once, scraping your hands and feet, but stubbornness pushes you onward. After a long and difficult struggle, you finally reach the top, panting and exhausted.

choices.text: Catch your breath and look at what lies ahead.

rock_climb_fail.text: You attempt to climb the wall despite your aching muscles. it's going fine for a while, but when the top is at arm's length, those very arms of yours give up and you fall, head first, into the warm but fortunately soft sand. The easy way isn't going to cut it for you. You'll need to find another way up.

choices.text: Scan the area for a clever way up. (Intelligence DC 12)
Play it safe and look for another path along the cliff. (HP Penalty)

rock_search_solution_success.text: You take a step back and carefully study the surroundings. After a moment, you notice two useful elements: a thick, old tree trunk at the top of the cliff and a long vine at your feet. You throw the vine around the trunk with a careful swing. It holds firm. Using it as a rope, you climb the wall with far less risk and reach the top, still tired but in one piece.

choices.text: Turn toward the land beyond the cliff.

rock_search_solution_fail.text: You analyze your surroundings. Besides a few wandering crabs and algae, you eye catches nothing of value. The smart way up is out of the question.

choices.text: Try to climb the rocky wall anyway. (Strength DC 15)
Play it safe and look for another path along the cliff. (HP Penalty)

rock_long_way.text: You choose caution over bravado and follow the cliff face, searching for any sign of a natural passage. You walk and walk, your legs growing heavier with each step. At last, hidden in the rock, you find an old stone stairway carved into the cliff. Every step burns what little strength you have left, but you eventually emerge at the top, drained but alive.

choices.text: Look around from the top of the cliffs.

cliff_top.text: At the top, you take one last look at the endless ocean stretching toward the horizon. There is no turning back now. Ahead of you, two paths present themselves. To your left: a misty bridge crossing a deep ravine, its planks old and suspicious. To your right: a dark forest, thick with twisted trees and shadows hiding who-knows-what. What do you choose ?

choices.text: Take the misty, fragile bridge.
Enter the dark, unnerving forest.

bridge_start.text: You step onto the bridge. The old wooden plank groans under your weight. A second step, then a third. Each creak echoes through the ravine below, reminding you how far you would fall if the bridge failed you. Still, you press on, one careful step at a time.

choices.text: Keep advancing, trying not to look down.

bridge_collapse.text: You advance slowly, every muscle tense. Strange, distant cries rise from the abyss, chilling your blood. You have no desire to find out what makes those sounds. Just as the far side of the ravine finally comes into view, one last crack rings out. The bridge gives way beneath your feet. You fall into the void, arms flailing.

choices.text: Reach out for anything that might save you.

saved_from_fall.text: As you plummet, a hand bursts through the mist and grabs your wrist at the last possible moment. With a grunt, someone hauls you toward the cliff edge. You slam against the rock, coughing and shaking, then climb up with your rescuer’s help. You collapse on solid ground, breathing hard.

choices.text: Thank the stranger and take a better look at them.

bandits_appear.text: You manage to stand. The man who saved you studies you in silence. His eyes stop on your medallion. He whistles. A dozen rough-looking figures appear from the fog and the rocks around you, surrounding you in a tight circle. They are all armed and grinning. You finally understand: these are bandits, and your savior is their leader. He pulls out a blade and points it at your chest.

choices.text: Hand over the medallion without resisting.
Refuse and prepare to fight, even if it means dying here.
Search your mind for a fire spell and try to cast it. (Intelligence DC 12)
These bandits don't look too bright. Attempt to negotiate with a well-crafted lie. (Charisma DC 15)

bandits_take_medallion.text: You decide not to play the hero. You take the medallion off your neck and hand it to the bandit leader. He snatches it from your fingers and raises it for everyone to see, basking in the greed of his men. After slipping the medallion into his pouch, he gives you a cruel look. His words make it clear: giving the medallion does not guarantee your survival.

choices.text: Wait for whatever comes next.

stand_your_ground.text: You tighten your fists and square your shoulders. You will not let them take the medallion without a fight. The bandits laugh at the sight of a naked, exhausted stranger trying to look threatening. One of them steps forward, ready to smash your face in. Outnumbered and unarmed, you know the outcome is already written in blood.

choices.text: Brace yourself for the inevitable.

attempt_fireball_success.text: You reach deep into your fractured memories, searching for an incantation. A simple fire spell, the very first lesson of most young mages. The formula surfaces in your mind, shaky but complete. You mutter the words and focus. A small spark appears in your hand and bursts into a weak fireball, which hits the nearest bandit. The man stumbles back, more surprised than hurt. Now they are angry.

choices.text: Face the bandits’ reaction to your magic.

attempt_fireball_fail.text: You reach deep into your fractured memories, searching for an incantation. A simple fire spell, the very first lesson of most young mages. The formula surfaces in your mind, shaky but complete. You mutter the words and focus. A small spark appears in your hand and bursts into...nothing. Just a puff of smoke. The bandits laugh at you in unission, still determined to end you.

choices.text: Brace yourself for the inevitable.

attempt_negotiation_success.text: You raise your hands, not in surrender, but in confidence. With a calm voice, you tell the bandits a story: a powerful wizard grants eternal life to whoever brings him your medallion. The catch, you insist, is that only one person can receive immortality. The bait is cast. The leader claims the reward for himself, but his men do not agree.

choices.text: Watch their greed twist the situation.

attempt_negotiation_fail.text: You raise your hands, but not in surrender. You try to come up with a good story that would instill doubt among the bandits. But your mind goes blank, you can't find your words, you stutter. A total disaster. The bandits, pissed that you dared open your mouth, will cut out your tongue first.

choices.text: Brace yourself for the inevitable.

bandits_internal_conflict.text: Your lie works too well. The bandits turn on one another, screaming that they each deserve the reward. Blades are drawn. What started as a simple argument explodes into a brutal brawl. One by one, they stab, slash and crush each other. In the end, only the leader remains, drenched in blood and panting heavily. He grabs you by the collar and pulls you close, madness burning in his eyes. He is about to kill you to make absolutely sure no one else can claim your so-called immortality.

choices.text: Stare into his eyes as he raises his weapon.

eden_rescue_bandits.text: The tension is unbearable. The bandits close in, talking about how much your body will sell for on the slave markets of Li'ark, or how amusing it would be to kill you right here. One of them grabs your arm. Another raises a club. Just as the first blow is about to fall, an arrow whistles through the air and buries itself in a bandit’s throat. A second arrow follows, then a third. The men around you fall in confusion and terror.

choices.text: Try to understand what is happening.

eden_rescue_bandits_leader.text: In the chaos, the leader seizes you and uses you as a living shield. You feel the cold steel of his blade against your neck. "Show yourself!" he roars at the unseen archer. For a moment, everything is still. Then a final arrow flies. It grazes your shoulder but somehow manages to sink deep into the bandit’s back. He stiffens, drops his weapon and collapses at your feet, not dead but deeply asleep. Some kind of potent sleeping poison coats the arrowhead.

choices.text: Turn toward the mysterious archer who saved you.

eden_rescue_bandits_negotiation.text: The leader suddenly collapses to the ground. You notice an arrow buried deep in his backside. Where did that come from? You hear someone approaching behind you, their footsteps calm and unhurried.

choices.text: Turn toward the source of the arrow.

forest_entry.text: You choose the forest. You gather what courage you have left and step into the tangle of dark trees. The shadows swallow you whole. Strange animal cries echo between the trunks, making you jump. You force yourself to breathe slowly and keep moving, deeper into the woods.

choices.text: Continue along the narrow forest path.

spider_web.text: After nearly an hour of walking, you stumble upon a gigantic spiderweb stretching from tree to tree, thick as a curtain. You push aside some of the silk and freeze. A monstrous spider is at work, wrapping one of its prey in webbing. Not just any prey: a frail elf, whose twisted body shows he died slowly and painfully.

choices.text: Retreat carefully and try to hide without making a sound. (Dexterity DC 15)
Grab a sturdy branch and let out a menacing roar. (Charisma DC 18)
Try to recall a basic fire spell and use magic. (Intelligence DC 12)

hide_from_spider_fail.text: You slowly back away, watching every step you take. But then, a dry twig cracks under your foot and your heart stops. Alerted, the spider notices you immediately. It screeches and turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Face what seems to be your end.

hide_from_spider_success.text: You slowly back away, watching every step you take. Suddenly, you freeze. You were this close to stepping on a dry twig. You walk carefully around it and slip behind a tree. When the creature is done with its meal, it drops the lifeless elf from its web and begins to crawl along the silk strands, searching for a new position.

choices.text: Stay hidden and hope it moves away.

scaring_spider_success.text: You snatch up a thick branch and brandish it like a makeshift spear. Then, you scream at the giant spider in a deep, threatening voice. The beast jumps then freezes. It examines you, not knowing if confronting a scary beast like you is worth its life. Finally, the spider obeys its survival instinct and climbs on the webbed trees. You take this opportunity to hide behind a tree.

choices.text: Face what seems to be your end.

scaring_spider_fail.text: You snatch up a thick branch and brandish it like a makeshift spear. Then, you scream at the giant spider in a deep, threatening voice. At least, you try. Your voice breaks like the one of a teenager. The beast, not impressed at all, screeches and turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Face what seems to be your end.

forest_attempt_fireball_success.text: You close your eyes and let your mind drift through broken memories. A basic fire spell surfaces: the first trick taught to young mages. You whisper the incantation and focus. A tiny flame appears in your hand and leaps toward the spider. It would have worked, if the creature wasn't so quick on its feet. It steps back right on time and then turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Look for a last-second miracle.

forest_attempt_fireball_fail.text: You close your eyes and let your mind drift through broken memories. A basic fire spell surfaces: the first trick taught to young mages. You whisper the incantation and focus. But nothing happens. If a spider could laugh, it would certainly do it. But instead, the creature screeches and turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Look for a last-second miracle.

eden_rescue_spider_hide.text: Still hidden behind your tree, you watch the spider move along its web, looking for a new angle, perhaps another prey. Suddenly, an arrow flies out of the undergrowth and pierces one of its eyes. The beast lets out a horrible screech. A second arrow slams into its abdomen, then a third. Each shot is precise and deliberate. The spider convulses and collapses onto the forest floor.

choices.text: Step out of your hiding place.

eden_rescue_spider_danger.text: The spider looms above you, ready to plunge its fangs into your flesh. Just as it strikes, an arrow whistles past your ear and buries itself in one of its many eyes. The beast rears back in agony. Another arrow slams into its body, then another. You shield your face as the monstrous creature collapses on top of you, dead weight pressing the air from your lungs.

choices.text: Struggle out from under the corpse.

eden_appears_common.text: You hear a cheerful whistle and a finger snap before you see anyone. A man steps out of his hiding place and calmly pulls his arrows from the fresh corpses of the bandits. He walks past you at first, ignoring you as if you were just another piece of scenery. Then he stops by the unconscious leader at your feet. Only then does he turn toward you. He starts laughing.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

eden_appears_common_negotiation.text: You hear a cheerful whistle and a finger snap before you see anyone. A man steps out of his hiding place and calmly surveys the bodies scattered around you, nodding once as if inspecting a job already done. He walks past you at first, ignoring you as if you were just another piece of scenery. Then he stops by the unconscious leader at your feet. Only then does he turn toward you. He starts laughing.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

eden_appears_forest.text: You hear a cheerful whistle and a finger snap before you see anyone. A man steps out of his hiding place and calmly pulls his arrows from the corpse of the giant spider. He walks past you at first, ignoring you as if you were just another piece of scenery. Then he stops by the broken body of the elf still tangled in the web. Only then does he turn toward you. He starts laughing.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

eden_description_and_clothes.text:
"Hey there, stranger ! Isn't it a bit cold to walk around with your backside out in the open?" he says.
A shy beard eats half his face, greasy long hair hides the other half. An eyepatch covers his left eye. He points at one of the corpses lying nearby.
"Go on, get dressed. They won't need their clothes where they're going..."
You strip one of the dead and finally envelop your skin with warm, rough fabric. If you had lost your medallion in the chaos, you find it again and hang it back around your neck.

choices.text: Ask who he is and what he is doing here.
Thank him for saving your life.

eden_description_and_clothes_forest.text:
"Hey there, stranger ! Isn't it a bit cold to walk around with your backside out in the open?" he says.
A shy beard eats half his face, greasy long hair hides the other half. An eyepatch covers his left eye. He points at the dead elf hanging in the web. "Go on then, take his clothes. This poor elf certainly won't need them anymore... "
You strip the unfortunate elf and finally envelop your skin with warm, rough fabric. If you had lost your medallion in the chaos, you find it again and hang it back around your neck.

choices.text: Ask who he is and what he is doing here.
Thank him for saving your life.

eden_explains_hunt_bridge.text:
The hunter shrugs. "Saving you? That too, I suppose. But truth is, I was mostly interested in that one." He nudges the unconscious bandit leader with his boot.
"Name's Regalus. Nasty piece of work. There's a bounty of a thousand gold pieces on his head if I bring him back alive. Not bad for a few days of work." He nods toward the arrow still sticking from the man's back.
"Sleeping poison. Very efficient."

choices.text: Follow him to his horse and the captured bandit.

eden_explains_hunt_bridge_alt.text:
"Funny attitude for someone who was about to end up gutted by a pack of roadside scum..." he says with a crooked smile.
"If you insist: I'm a bounty hunter, and I just caught my latest prey. I was heading to the nearest city, cutting across this area, when I spotted a golden opportunity: Regalus and his little gang of idiots." He jerks his chin toward the unconscious bandit leader.
"The poison on my arrows makes the perfect sleeping draught, ideal for a hunter like me. I decided to put it to good use. Saving you was just a side effect. Fortunate for you, isn't it?"

choices.text: Follow him to his horse and the captured bandit.

eden_explains_hunt_forest.text:
The hunter snorts. "Saving you? Oh, that too, I suppose. Truth is, I was far more interested in this creature's venom." He jerks his chin toward the spider’s corpse.
"Potent stuff. A powerful sleeping draught. I'm a bounty hunter, you see. I actually caught my latest target not far from here, Regalus is the name, (not that his name actually matters), but to do that I had to use the very last drops of venom I had left. So stumbling on this spider was a blessing... and stumbling on you as well, of course, ahem."

choices.text: Follow him through the trees to his horse.

eden_explains_hunt_forest_alt.text:
"Strange way of talking for someone who was about to end up in an oversized insect's stomach..." the hunter says with a half-smile.
"If you insist: I'm a bounty hunter, and I've just bagged my latest prey. Regalus is the name. Nasty piece of work, with a gorgeous bounty on his head. I was on my way to the nearest city, cutting through this forest, when I noticed those webs above us." He points at the strands between the trees.
"The venom of these creatures makes the perfect sleeping draught, ideal for someone in my line of work. So I decided to bring it down. Saving you was just a side effect, fortunate for you, wouldn't you say?".

choices.text: Follow him through the trees to his horse.

eden_to_horse.text: You help the hunter drag the heavy, unconscious bandit toward his horse. One, two, three: together you heave the body over the saddle. The hunter climbs up behind his prisoner.

choices.text: Ask what he intends to do with this man.

eden_to_horse_forest.text: You follow the hunter through the undergrowth until you reach a small clearing. His horse waits there, calm and patient. A large man is already tied across the saddle, snoring loudly: Regalus, no doubt under the effect of the sleeping poison. The hunter adjusts the ropes with quick, efficient gestures.

choices.text: Ask what he intends to do with this man.

eden_small_talk.text:
"What I'm going to do with him?" the hunter snorts.
"Boil him with vegetables and potatoes. What do you think? I'm taking him to collect the bounty, of course." He smirks.

choices.text: Listen as he turns the conversation back to you.

eden_asks_story.text: The hunter tilts his head, studying you. "Anyway," he says, "enough about me. What's your story? Not that I really care, but I'm curious to know what a clown like you is doing, naked, in the middle of these wild lands."

choices.text: Tell him about your amnesia and how you woke up on the beach.

eden_reacts_amnesia.text: You explain that you woke up on the beach with no memory of your past, no idea who you were, until you found the medallion with your name on it. The hunter listens, surprisingly silent. "Amnesia, huh?" he finally mutters. He stares at you for a long moment, as if weighing an idea in his head. He gestures at the saddle, inviting you to climb up. Then he clicks his tongue and jerks his chin toward the horse.

choices.text: Climb onto the horse behind him.

eden_ride_to_city.text:
You climb up behind the bounty hunter. The horse shifts under your combined weight. "You must be hungry and thirsty," he says. "The bounty on Regalus will pay for the first round."
With a click of his tongue, the horse starts at a trot, then a gallop, crossing the valley at full speed. After a moment, he speaks again.
"The name's Eden. Pleasure to meet you. The nearest city is about two hours away. I hope your backside can handle the ride, stranger."
The wind lashes your face as the land rushes by and your strange new journey truly begins.
